title: Creating a Doom-style 3D engine in C
summary: Bisqwit builds a Doom or Duke Nukem 3D style software-rendered 3D engine in C from scratch, supporting non-Euclidean geometry. It covers vector rotation and portal rendering with sped-up, tool-assisted coding.
why: A favorite on Ask HN lists of programming YouTube channels, praised for mind-blowing systems and graphics programming and a watchable coding style.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: My favourite programming YouTuber by a long stretch.
